MarketBeat

Thu, August 6, 2026 at 7:04 AM MST 6 min read

Key Points

  • Interested in GFT Technologies SE? Here are five stocks we like better.

  • GFT reported solid first-half results: Revenue increased 5% to €462.6 million, while adjusted EBT rose 8% to €33 million and the adjusted EBT margin improved to 7.1%. The company reaffirmed its full-year revenue, profitability and free-cash-flow guidance.

  • Growth was led by AI and international markets: Brazil, Colombia, Switzerland and Spain posted strong gains, while the Americas and APAC grew 14%. GFT's AI Modernization offering won more than 20 projects, and its Wynxx platform generated €39.2 million in influenced revenue across software engineering and business-process applications.

  • Backlog and operational metrics strengthened: Order backlog rose 18% year over year, utilization increased to 92.8% and attrition declined to 10.4%. Cash flow remained seasonally negative in the first half but improved substantially from the prior year, while the company expects stronger performance in the third quarter.

GFT Technologies (ETR:GFT) reported first-half 2026 revenue growth of 5% and higher profitability, while reaffirming its full-year outlook as the company expanded its artificial intelligence-led services and won new banking, anti-money-laundering and modernization engagements.

Revenue for the six months ended June rose to €462.6 million, up 5% both on a reported and constant-currency basis. Adjusted earnings before taxes increased 8% to €33 million, lifting the adjusted EBT margin to 7.1% from 6.8% a year earlier. Reported EBT rose 26% to €24 million, with the margin improving to 5.2% from 4.3%.

→ 3 Drone Stocks That Should Soar After the Summer Slump

Global CEO Marco Santos said the results reflected "disciplined execution" of GFT's AI-centric five-year strategy, including tighter operational management and a growing contribution from AI-native services, the company's Wynxx Agentic AI platform, and higher-value offerings.

Growth led by Latin America and selected European markets

GFT said its strongest market growth came from Brazil, where revenue rose 38%, followed by Colombia at 27%, Switzerland at 22%, and Spain at 13%. By sector, industry and other clients grew 14%, insurance rose 7%, and banking increased 3%.

→ Meta's Earnings Drop Shows Wall Street Wants More Than Ad Growth

The Americas and APAC segment posted 14% revenue growth, driven principally by Brazil and Colombia. In Europe, revenue declined 3%, reflecting continued investment caution in Germany and a weaker first half in the U.K. The company said Spain delivered strong growth, while the U.K. business, though down 18% in the first half, had returned to profitability and was expected to resume year-over-year revenue growth beginning in the third quarter.

市场节奏

2026 年 8 月 6 日星期四上午 7:04（MST） 阅读 6 分钟

要点

  • 对 GFT Technologies SE 感兴趣？ 这是我们更喜欢的五只股票。
  • GFT 公布了稳健的上半年业绩：收入增长 5% 至 4.626 亿欧元，调整后息税前利润增长 8% 至 3300 万欧元，调整后息税前利润率提高至 7.1%。 该公司重申了全年收入、盈利能力和自由现金流指引。
  • 增长由人工智能和国际市场引领：巴西、哥伦比亚、瑞士和西班牙增长强劲，而美洲和亚太地区增长了 14%。 GFT 的 AI 现代化产品赢得了 20 多个项目，其 Wynxx​​ 平台在软件工程和业务流程应用程序方面产生了 3920 万欧元的影响收入。
  • 积压订单和运营指标得到加强：积压订单同比增长 18%，利用率提高至 92.8%，流失率下降至 10.4%。 上半年现金流仍呈季节性负值，但较去年同期大幅改善，而该公司预计第三季度业绩将更加强劲。

GFT Technologies（ETR：GFT）报告称，2026 年上半年收入增长 5%，盈利能力提高，同时重申了全年展望，因为该公司扩大了人工智能主导的服务，并赢得了新的银行、反洗钱和现代化业务。

截至 6 月的六个月收入增至 4.626 亿欧元，按报告和固定汇率计算均增长 5%。 调整后税前利润增长 8%，达到 3300 万欧元，调整后 EBT 利润率从上年同期的 6.8% 提高到 7.1%。 报告的 EBT 增长 26%，达到 2400 万欧元，利润率从 4.3% 提高到 5.2%。

→ 夏季低迷后应该会飙升的 3 只无人机股票

全球首席执行官 Marco Santos 表示，这一结果反映了 GFT 以 AI 为中心的五年战略的“严格执行”，包括更严格的运营管理以及 AI 原生服务、公司的 Wynxx​​ Agentic AI 平台和更高价值产品的贡献不断增加。

拉丁美洲和部分欧洲市场引领增长

GFT表示，最强劲的市场增长来自巴西，收入增长了38%，其次是哥伦比亚，增长27%，瑞士增长22%，西班牙增长13%。 按行业划分，工业及其他客户增长14%，保险增长7%，银行增长3%。

→ Meta 的盈利下降表明华尔街想要的不仅仅是广告增长

美洲和亚太地区收入增长 14%，主要由巴西和哥伦比亚推动。 在欧洲，收入下降3%，反映出德国投资持续谨慎以及英国上半年表现疲弱。该公司表示，西班牙业务增长强劲，而英国业务虽然上半年下降18%，但已恢复盈利，预计从第三季度开始将恢复同比收入增长。
